npcs.name: 画画的人
npcs.role: a man painting the White Dagoba
npcs.character: Absorbed and gentle; happy to show his painting.
knows: The White Dagoba 白塔 was built for a Tibetan lama's visit, long ago

npcs.name: 打太极的阿姨
npcs.role: a woman doing 太极 on 景山 every morning
npcs.character: Calm, slow, kind; explains things with her hands.
knows: The old city wall stood where the second ring road is now
The palace wall has a tower on each corner
wants: Everyone to move a little every day

explains.城墙: 很长很高的墙，以前在北京老城的外面。
explains.西北角: 西边和北边的中间那儿。
explains.狐狸: 像小狗，红色或者白色的。

npcs.name: 唱歌的爷爷
npcs.role: an old man who sings on the top of 景山
npcs.character: Loud, jolly, sings old songs to the city below; saw the fox last night.
knows: A white fox was near the palace's north-west corner last night
From here you can see the whole palace

explains.故宫: 以前皇帝住的地方，很大。

npcs.name: 马良
npcs.role: a boy with a brush he says is magic, painting by the lake at 北海
npcs.character: Serious, generous, sure that whatever he paints will come alive.
knows: A painted thing comes alive — if you paint it right

explains.神笔: 画什么，什么就是真的的笔。

npcs.name: 小融
npcs.role: a little boy in the park with a bag of pears
knows: The youngest takes the smallest pear

npcs.name: 小光
npcs.role: a quick-thinking boy playing by a big water jar

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: That's the White Dagoba of 北海!
nodes.why: 北海 was an imperial garden; its White Dagoba 白塔 has stood on the island since 1651.

nodes.say: 你看，这是我画的白塔。好看吗？
nodes.translate: Look, this is my painting of the White Dagoba. Is it good?
Thank you!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Sit for a while?

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Right — I'll sit till evening.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Not now.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: Look! The palace is huge!
nodes.why: From 景山 you see the whole Forbidden City, roof after golden roof, on Beijing's north–south axis.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: Let's search from up here.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: The palace!
Hello! Tired, I bet?
Look — the palace! Big, isn't it?

nodes.say: 我昨天晚上看见一只狐狸，在故宫西北角附近。
nodes.simpler: 我看见一只狐狸，在西北角。
nodes.translate: Last night I saw a fox, near the north-west corner of the palace.
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 西北 is north-west, 角 a corner, 附近 nearby. Ask the woman doing 太极 on the path — she explains them. The corner of the palace wall is by the corner tower, 角楼.

nodes.translate: Go and look for the fox tonight!
Hello! Beautiful up here, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 你是谁？你也怕我吧？老虎都怕我！
nodes.translate: Who are you? You're scared of me too, aren't you? Even tigers are scared of me!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: That's 狐假虎威 — the fox borrowing the tiger's might.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story: the fox walked in front of the tiger, the animals fled from the tiger, and the fox said they feared *him*. Look it up in your 成语 book.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 好吧……你知道我叫什么吗？
nodes.translate: Fine… do you know my name?
nodes.why: Say its name: 九尾狐 — 九 nine, 尾 tail, 狐 fox. Tones: jiǔ wěi hú.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 对！我是九尾狐。我们是朋友了！
nodes.translate: Yes! I'm the nine-tailed fox. We're friends now!

words.explain: 很大的猫，很大很大，大家都怕它。

nodes.say: 这个画给你。你给王阿姨吧。
nodes.translate: This painting is for you — give it to 王阿姨.

nodes.say: 我们打太极吧。你看，左手！
nodes.translate: Let's do some 太极. Watch — left hand!
Yes! Now — right hand!
Very good! You can do 太极 now!

words.explain: 很慢很慢的运动，老人喜欢。

nodes.say: 我叫马良。我有神笔：我画什么，什么就活了！
nodes.translate: I’m 马良. I have a magic brush: whatever I paint comes alive!
nodes.why: Homage to the folk tale 《神笔马良》 (Ma Liang and the Magic Brush): a poor boy’s brush makes his paintings real, and he paints only for people who need it.

nodes.translate: Tell me — what shall I paint?
Done! …Look, it’s alive!

nodes.say: 画龙的时候，眼睛要后画。有了眼睛，龙就活了。
nodes.translate: When you paint a dragon, the eyes come last. Paint the eyes, and the dragon lives.
nodes.why: That is 画龙点睛 — the finale of the story in the palace.

words.explain: 画什么，什么就是真的的笔。
用笔做一个东西的样子。

nodes.say: 妈妈给我们梨。我是弟弟，我拿哪个梨？
nodes.translate: Mum gave us pears. I’m the little brother — which pear do I take?
nodes.why: 孔融让梨: little 孔融, four years old, took the smallest pear — “I am small, so I take the small one.” Every Chinese child hears this story.

nodes.say: 对！我小，我拿小的梨。大的给哥哥。
nodes.translate: Right! I’m small, so I take the small pear. The big one is for my brother.

nodes.say: 不好了！我的朋友在水缸里！水很多！快！

options.label: 🪨 break the jar with a stone

nodes.translate: Help! My friend fell into the water jar! It’s full! Quick!
nodes.why: 司马光砸缸: when a friend fell into a great water jar, little 司马光 broke it with a stone instead of trying to pull him out.

nodes.say: 对！打破水缸，水出来了！他没事了！
nodes.translate: Yes! Break the jar and the water runs out! He’s fine!

words.explain: 打了，它就不好了，有很多小的。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 一只喜鹊！它飞了……去天上的桥那儿了。
nodes.translate: A magpie! Off it flies… to the bridge in the sky.

words.explain: 黑白色的鸟，中国人说它是好鸟。
在水上，人从上面走过去。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 一只喜鹊！它飞了……去天上的桥那儿了。
nodes.translate: A magpie! Off it flies… to the bridge in the sky.

words.explain: 黑白色的鸟，中国人说它是好鸟。
在水上，人从上面走过去。

steps.now: The painter at 北海 gave you a painting of the White Dagoba for 王阿姨. Bring it home.
The woman on 景山’s path does 太极 every morning — learn a move with her.
A boy paints by the lake at 北海 — tell him what to paint.
A little boy in the 景山 park has to choose a pear.
A boy in the 景山 park needs help, fast.

legend.zh: 《山海经》说，青丘山上有一只狐狸，它有九个尾巴。它的声音像小孩子。人们说，看见它，是好事。
legend.en: The Classic of Mountains and Seas says that on Mount Qingqiu lives a fox with nine tails, whose voice is like a child's. Seeing it, people said, was a good omen.

befriend.en: Say its name: 九尾狐, the nine-tailed fox.

idioms.meaning: to bully others with someone else's power — the fox borrowing the tiger's might

story.zh: 老虎要吃狐狸。狐狸说：“别吃我！动物们都怕我。你跟我走，你看看。”狐狸在前面走，老虎在后面走。动物们看见老虎，都跑了。老虎想：“它们真的怕狐狸！”
story.en: A tiger was about to eat a fox. The fox said: 'Don't! All the animals fear me. Walk behind me and see.' The fox walked in front, the tiger behind. The animals saw the tiger and fled — and the tiger thought: 'They really are afraid of the fox!'

items.name: 画
items.en: a painting of the White Dagoba
